sentences.text: The scheme is known as the State Rural Health Mission Scheme for Youth (SRHMSY).
It is implemented in the context of improving healthcare access and services in rural areas.
The objective is to enhance the health status of rural youth by providing them with necessary healthcare services.
The scheme benefits rural youth by offering health awareness programs and access to medical facilities.
Eligibility criteria include being a resident of rural areas and falling within the age group specified by the scheme.
The application process typically involves registration at local health centers or through designated online platforms.
The timeline for the implementation of the scheme is ongoing with periodic assessments.
The implementing authorities include the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare at the state level.
Additional details may include partnerships with local NGOs for outreach and awareness activities.
